crossRefs.note: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will…

Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them,

Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am…
From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is…
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures…
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

translations.web: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
translations.asv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.
